meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 它对 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等数据文件进行分析,支持分组汇总、关联、时间序列、分布、清洗和绘图;回答问题后报告行数和耗时,先探测数据再选择执行方式。
howto.when: 当你要分析 CSV/Parquet/JSON 等数据文件,或进行聚合、清洗、绘图等数据操作时触发。

say.text: 分析这份 CSV,按年份统计销售总额。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并返回分组聚合结果。

say.text: 这几个 Parquet 文件按 ID 连接,输出合并后的行数。
say.note: 会执行连接并报告结果行数。

say.text: 画一下这个 JSON 数据随时间变化的趋势图。
say.note: 会生成图表并附简要说明。

howto.what_en: Processes and analyzes data files (CSV/Parquet/JSON) with DuckDB/Polars or one-shot tools, including grouping, joins, time series, distributions, cleaning, and plotting. Reports row counts and timing after answering.
howto.when_en: Use when analyzing CSV/Parquet/JSON files, or when performing aggregation, cleaning, plotting tasks.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV and sum sales by year.
say_en.note: Claude reads the file and returns grouped results.

say_en.text: Join these Parquet files by ID and output the resulting row count.
say_en.note: Performs the join and reports the count.

say_en.text: Plot this JSON data's trend over time.
say_en.note: Produces a chart with a brief explanation.
